title: royal-star line, same-target pair, both ends on X (tight)
text: A natal royal-star line R – X scores; a sky pair S A – S B (A, B not X) is on the same family and target; A and B each reach X in the sky (S – S X) and in the star line's chart (S → natal X).
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Mercury

title: two royal stars on X, sky and natal, same chart
text: In one chart, two different royal stars each score on X in the sky (S R – S X) and in that natal chart (R – X), each star in one plane (the same plane for its sky and natal line).
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Mars

title: royal-star line, same-target pair, one end on natal X, same family
text: A natal royal-star line R – X scores; a sky pair S A – S B (A, B not X) is on the same family and target; at least one of A, B has a scoring S → natal X line in the star line's chart, on the same family as the target.
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Jupiter

title: royal-star line and same-body line, same-plane ratio, both paired
text: In one chart, the royal-star line R – X and the same-body line S X → natal X in the same plane both score, their same-body ratio is on an interval, and each of the two lines has a sky pair on its own family and target.
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Saturn

title: crossed same-body ratio on a cut in both charts
text: A royal-star line in the horse chart and one in the jockey chart each give a crossed same-body ratio on a cut (1/10 ... 1/20) scoring >= 80 (80 provisional).
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Uranus

title: royal-star loop
text: The same-body line S X → natal X scores and a sky pair S A – S R on its target holds a royal star R, whose natal line R – X in that chart has a scoring same-body (same plane) or crossed (other plane) ratio against that same-body line.
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Uranus

title: paired same-body line with a royal-star ratio, second star line paired
text: In one chart, the same-body line (plane p) scores and has a sky pair on its target; a royal star R's line in plane p has a scoring same-body ratio against it (R's line need not score); another royal star's line on X in that chart scores and has its own sky pair.
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Neptune

title: two royal stars with same-plane and crossed ratios
text: In one chart, two different royal stars each have a scoring same-body ratio and a scoring crossed same-body ratio (star lines and same-body lines need not score).
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Rahu

title: star line matched by a pair holding the same star, other end on X in both charts
text: A natal royal-star line R – X scores; a sky pair S A – S R (the same star) is on its family and target; A reaches X in both charts (S A → H X and S A → J X).
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Rahu

title: one royal star on X in sky, horse and jockey; star line paired with both ends on sky X
text: A royal star R scores on sky X (S R – S X); its natal line R – X in both charts has a score or a scoring ratio; one scoring natal R – X line is matched by a sky pair S A – S B whose ends both reach sky X.
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Ketu

title: additive star step + one star in both planes (combination)
text: In one chart, both: (a) a royal star R1 scores on X in the sky and natal, same plane and family (whole / golden), with the same-body line in that plane on the same family and the multipliers adding up; (b) a royal star R2 line scores in one plane with a sky pair, and R2 in the other plane has a scoring same-body ratio against a scoring same-body line.
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Ceres

title: star line repeated by sky X with Y, Y back on natal X
text: A natal royal-star line R – X scores; a sky line S X – S Y (X itself with Y) is on its family and target (any family); Y reaches natal X in the star line's chart.
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Pallas

title: same-body line in both charts, each paired
text: S X → H X and S X → J X both score and each has its own sky pair S A – S B (A, B not X) on its family and target.
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Juno

title: H X – J X line paired, both ends on natal X in one chart
text: The H X – J X line scores; a sky pair S A – S B (A, B not X) is on its family and target; A and B both reach natal X in the same chart.
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Vesta

title: star target held by a same-star pair and by S Y on the other chart, Y back
text: A natal royal-star line R – X in chart c scores (not conj); on its family and target there are a sky pair holding R and a line S Y → X in the other chart; Y also reaches X in chart c.
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Chiron

title: same-body number repeated by Y on natal X, Y on sky X
text: The same-body line S X → natal X scores (not conj / contraparallel); a sky body Y (not a light) has S Y → that chart's X on the same family and target; Y scores on sky X (any family).
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Eris

title: H X – J X number repeated by Y on natal X, Y on sky X same family
text: The H X – J X line scores; a sky body Y (not a light) has S Y → natal X on the same family and target; Y scores on sky X on the same family.
origin: Lingfield AW 14:35 2 Apr 2021, 5 Pholas / Hollie Doyle, body Makemake

title: H X – J X line matched by a pair holding a royal star that is on X in sky and natal; other end on X
text: The H X – J X line scores; a sky pair S A – S R holding a royal star R is on its family and target; R scores on X in the sky (S R – S X) and in a natal chart (R – X), same plane; A reaches X (S A – S X or S A → natal X).
